basics.name: Johanna Kowalska-Nielsen
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Senior frontend engineer with 11 years of experience building design systems and data-heavy web applications. Led the 2024 rewrite of a customer analytics platform, cutting median page load from 4.2s to 1.1s and lifting weekly active usage by 18%. Cares about typography, performance budgets, and interfaces that respect their readers.
